notes.title: Update v1.7.0 - 3 new cars and improvements to Ball Game and Cops and Robbers.
notes.content: [p]Dear Racers,[/p][p]A new update has arrived featuring three new vehicles and enhancements to [i]Ball Game mode[/i] and [i]Cops and Robbers[/i]. [/p][p][/p][p][b][u]Now’s a great time to wishlist. The Autumn Sale is coming, and it will include a deeper discount.[/u][/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]New Vehicles:[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45503036/ea7c5cbe3fd1ebb5eadb05764213a461f1bc5b13.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45503036/732463feca17ca78e6f7afdc7531aa2ac203b52c.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45503036/f42266d0b3773763fdd0dfe683fee663804b915a.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]The new cars are initially locked. Each one is unlocked by completing its corresponding Racer Duel challenge from the challenges menu in Single Player.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Ball Game Improvements:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Matches are now time-based: 5 minutes, no goal cap.[/p][/*][*][p]Tied matches go to overtime; first goal wins.[/p][/*][*][p]Stadium corners and sides are now rounded; side obstacles removed.[/p][/*][*][p]Ball visibility improved in dark stages.[/p][/*][*][p]Goal areas are color-highlighted for clarity.[/p][/*][*][p]In two-player matches, players now face each other at kickoff.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45503036/ed4178772a225b9a170a288ad83cba4ae0426f12.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Cops and Robbers Improvements:[/b][/p][list][*][p]The helicopter escape route has been adjusted to give cops a slight advantage, replacing the flat terrain from earlier versions.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45503036/dffd5942b468163cded3ff5139060e55f162da85.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]The safe house is now located deeper within a hidden area, no longer visibly placed at the side of the map.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45503036/f4ff4e09b1de5a4082d1a0417f37da9293860754.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]I hope you enjoy the new cars and improvements, and please feel free to share your feedback![/p][p][/p][p]A-Grand HT[/p]

notes.title: Game Update v1.6.5

Playable in both single-player and split-screen multiplayer formats.[/p][p][/p][p]Key features:[/p][list][*][p]Jumping and boosting mechanics for a little dynamic movement[/p][/*][*][p]Balanced controls for competitive gameplay[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Additional Improvements:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed camera issue in Nurbingnord causing black screen in one of the players screens[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed camera placement for Rane Pickup[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked Helicopter zone in Townsville to help cops better counter robbers’ escape routes[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]I hope you enjoy the new Ball Game mode.[/p][p][/p][p]Please feel free to share your thoughts and feedback.[/p]

notes.title: Patch - v1.2.2
notes.content:
[b]Patch v1.2.2 - Small Fixes & Enhancements[/b]

[b]Fixes:[/b]

Resolved an issue where the arrow pointer in Cops and Robbers was visible in other players’ cameras.

Improved visibility of gold at night in Townsville.

Gold no longer casts shadows to prevent confusion.


[b]Townsville Map Changes:[/b]

Redesigned the residential section with more realistic houses, reduced ramps, and widened areas for a better racing experience.

Adjusted the Helipad area for improved Cops and Robbers gameplay balance.

Introduced a new diner in front of the Bank to reduce overly wide spaces.


[b]Bonus Content:[/b]

Added an additional police car in Cops and Robbers mode.



If you encounter any issues or have suggestions, feel free to share. Thanks!

notes.title: Game Update v1.2.1
notes.content:
Update Notes – v1.2.1:

Content Updates:  
- Added two sportier variations of Fugex and Imploder.
- Added a new map: Riverside Village, available in both day and night versions.  
- Added a night version of Townsville.
- Introduced Timed Event Challenges.

Graphics Improvements:  
- Enhanced textures for a more detailed and immersive look.  
- Optimized performance, ensuring smoother gameplay and better visuals.  

Quality of Life Enhancements:  
- Improved UI for Cops and Robbers mode for better clarity and functionality.  
- Graphics presets optimized for lower-end devices, making gameplay smoother for a wider range of players.

notes.title: Graphics Update v1.1.1
notes.content:
Greetings, Racers! 

I’m excited to roll out a new update focused on enhancing the visual appeal and overall gameplay experience. This update brings significant improvements to aesthetics, making the game look sharper, more vibrant, and more optimized for a smoother ride.  

[b]Visual Enhancements:[/b]
- Richer and more refined color tones  
- Improved textures for a cleaner look  
- Enhanced post-processing for better atmosphere  
- Better shadows and improved ambient occlusion  
- Major performance optimizations for higher frame rates  
- Added track details for a more engaging race environment  
- Improved horizon visuals, adding depth to the racing experience  
- Updated tree models for a better overall aesthetic  

[b]Quality-of-Life Improvements:[/b]
- Grand Tour Mode - Your selected car, color, and last track are now saved, allowing you to seamlessly resume your previous session  
- Circuit & Sprint Race Enhancements - Vehicle completion times are now displayed to provide clearer race standings  
- The last player will have a 30-second timer to complete the race—if not finished within the limit, the race will automatically conclude  
- Battle Mode Update - Players will now compete for points, with the first to reach five becoming the champion  
- Audio Improvements: - Upgraded some sound effects for a more immersive racing experience  
- Slipstreaming Mechanic - If you chase a fast-moving car, you'll gain speed more efficiently, making overtaking more strategic and rewarding  
- Smarter AI Behavior - AI drivers now try to reduce collisions with the player while adjusting their driving for a more competitive and fluid racing experience  

Thanks for your support. Keep racing!
